text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On that day, the cheers that had divided 
the venue into two... became one massive 
swell.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Orfevre! Orfevre! Orfeeeee~~!! 
Orfevre...!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Strong! Undeniably strong! Generational 
barriers mean nothing to the King!! And 
the winner is Orfevre—!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Listen!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A single roar cut through the cheers, 
instantly commanding silence. Orfevre 
looked around leisurely with a satisfied 
air, and continued—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
The banquet has drawn to a close. The 
foolish masses should understand by now.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
From this point on, the pinnacle belongs 
to me alone.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Cast aside allegiance to all others. Obey 
the King of All Peoples.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
The Golden Age has dawned. Welcome it with 
cheers!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Oooohh...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The moment Orfevre let out a roar, the 
loudest cheer of the day erupted—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I shouldn't have come.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: It's too bright... —I can't see anymore.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Orfevre grows stronger with every race, 
shining ever brighter. The slightest 
concerns I had back in her Junior year 
don't even cross my mind anymore.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
—Sisters conquering the Arima Kinen would 
be a first in history... That's amazing.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Pulling off maneuvering like that against 
top-tier Senior Class opponents... There's 
nobody left in Japan who can beat her!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: ... ...In that case...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
With Orfevre... she might even be able to 
rule the entire world, wouldn't she...?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: "If it's that King...! Just maybe...!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Upon her return, Orfevre quietly uttered 
just a single phrase.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Make the preparations.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I shall head towards that land.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The gold pendant hanging from my neck 
swayed. It brought back memories of last 
year—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
That distant land... has become far too 
distant.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
A longing past its time, a fully ripened 
dream...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Everything... I will smash it all to 
pieces.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
—The time is ripe. I shall grant the "Prix 
de l'Arc de Triomphe" the honor of my 
presence.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe... The 
highest summit Orfevre has had her eyes on 
ever since the start of her Junior 
year—no, even before that...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
It seems there are fools who believe that 
faraway land has slipped further out of 
reach once more...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Last year, Nakayama Festa finished in 2nd 
place, the closest any Japanese challenger 
has ever come to victory...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She took on the ultimate pinnacle again 
this year, but... She sank to 11th place 
and returned home in dejection. While an 
air of defeat hangs over the fans, 
whispering that victory is impossible—
choice_data_list:
If it's you... you can stand atop that 
peak!

If it's you... you can stand atop that 
peak!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...No, that's not quite right.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I am the one. I will be the one…… to stand 
at that pinnacle.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
The fact that no winner has ever emerged 
until now is proof of that.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: That crown... —is waiting for me.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe is in 
October. Since I was left to choose the 
races to run before then, I pondered which 
races would be most fitting for Orfevre."
choice_data_list: First up is the Tenno Sho (Spring)!
First up is the Tenno Sho (Spring), right!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Spring) is a 3,200m 
long-distance race open only to Senior 
Class runners. A race with such prestige 
is surely what Orfevre seeks.
choice_data_list:
(Still, the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, 
huh...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My heart races. Winning that race is the 
long-cherished dream of Japanese racing. 
If Orfevre wins—it will be a historic 
feat.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Orfevre will achieve historical greatness 
from here on... Pondering that destiny, I 
suddenly felt the pendant on my chest—and 
touched it.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Foolish creature. Your voice is echoing 
throughout the area.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: "Oh, aren't you coming in?"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"She seems to be in high spirits. Let her 
keep working."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: He's just a single-minded man, after all.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
She's just a single-minded woman, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: "...Hey, Orfe. How about now?"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Is he a jester, or a true guiding staff?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Is she a jester, or indeed a guiding cane?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph. Still playing the clown, I see.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, they transform. Even into a 
cane... indeed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I had a dream.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a strange dream... Unlike before, 
it was formless. Yet, a certain emotion 
lingered strongly—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A blood-curdling despair.
